symptom: The e30 mid-anchor guarded parent failed the offline start-policy alignment precheck against seed63402_edge_recovery_anchor.pt. On 76 edge recovery samples, mean KL was 2.131519 and argmax agreement was 0.0. On 32 success retention samples, argmax agreement was 1.0 but mean KL remained 0.759214, above the 0.25 threshold.
root_cause: The parent policy is too far from the learned edge-recovery repair distribution before PPO starts. It fully disagrees with the anchor on the edge recovery rows, so anchor regularization inside a short closed-loop PPO continuation is starting from a badly mismatched policy.
fix: Do not continue direct PPO regularization from this parent for the edge-recovery anchor. Use supervised SB3 initialization/distillation from the anchor or a narrower constrained opening branch, then rerun the alignment precheck before target-seed preflight.
validation: Ran compare_sb3_to_behavior_clone_anchor.py against edge_recovery_samples.jsonl and soda_success_opening_retention_samples.jsonl with max mean KL 0.25, min argmax agreement 0.85, and max bucket mean KL 0.25. Both reports returned behavior_clone_anchor_alignment_failed.
